name: opentype.js
category: A4. Vector, typography, diagrams and stills
role: Parse fonts to glyph outlines and SVG path data; text without installed fonts
summary: JavaScript parser and writer for OpenType, TrueType and WOFF fonts. Loads a font file and returns glyph metrics, kerning and vector paths that can be converted to SVG path data or drawn to canvas. Version 2 adds variable-font support. Its strength is turning text into outlines in plain code, so SVGs need no installed font and render identically everywhere.
use_when: Converting text to SVG paths so resvg or any browser renders identically without the font installed
Measuring text or per-glyph positions for kinetic type layout
Reading glyph outlines for stroke-draw or morph animation of letters
avoid_when: Complex scripts needing full shaping (Arabic, Indic): HarfBuzz-based tooling
Text in a normal browser scene: use CSS fonts and GSAP SplitText
Whole HTML-like layouts to SVG: Satori
notes: 2026-10-26: shaping support is basic (kerning and ligature tables); complex-script behaviour and variable-font claims in 2.0.0 not verified from source.

assessment.rationale: npm 2.0.0 published 2026-05-06 following 1.3.5 on 2026-04-29; repository pushed 2026-08-08; MIT. Standard route to glyph outlines in JavaScript.
